HOLD | | A3 | Conduit is grounded/bonded at both ends and intermediate boxes
Acceptance: Earth resistance ≤ 1 Ω measured between boxes | Cl. 8.3.1 — Earth continuity | OK
NC
NA

Acceptance: All cable entry points protected, no sharp edges, glands fitted | Cl. 7.1.3 — Mechanical protection | OK

Acceptance: Cable bundle diameter ≤ 0.4 × conduit ID | Cl. 7.2.3 — Conduit fill | OK
NC
NA

Acceptance: Box volume adequate, all cables accessible, no cramping | Cl. 7.3.1 — Box sizing | OK

Acceptance: Megger reading ≥ 1 MΩ, recorded and documented | Cl. 11.1 — Pre-commissioning test | OK
